summary: Most core requirements appear implemented: branding “Sabji wala” in UI and document title, a multi-section landing page with a non-blue/purple produce-themed palette, and a backend query endpoint wired to the frontend via React Query with a loading skeleton. However, the diff summary does not show the required generated image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated, even though the UI references them.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the generated image assets to the frontend as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them on the landing page (logo + hero).
missing_requirements.reason: The landing page/header reference image paths under /assets/generated, but the diff summary does not show any files added under frontend/public/assets/generated (only code files were added). Without the actual image files in public, the requirement is not fully implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/implemented Internet Identity authentication scaffolding and actor recreation/invalidation logic, even though authentication was explicitly not required for this request.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest states Internet Identity is allowed but not required; requirements only asked for a minimal backend endpoint + frontend fetch/display. The diff adds a full InternetIdentityProvider, useInternetIdentity hook, and an identity-aware useActor hook with query invalidation.

hallucinated_features.description: Added social media icon links/section (Facebook/Instagram/X) on the landing page.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement; landing page content requirements only specified header/hero and at least one informational section.
